# Jakarta Apartments — Ultra-Luxury Property Advisory

> Curated ultra-luxury apartment advisory in Jakarta CBD. Operated by PT Berjaya Global Makmur. Ten premium residential addresses across Sudirman, Kuningan, SCBD, Dharmawangsa, and Thamrin. Advisory contact: WhatsApp +62818-8288-8199, email info@jakartaapartments.co. Serving clients across Indonesia, Singapore, GCC, Europe, and Australia.

## Portfolio — Internal Pages

- [Two Sudirman Private Residences](https://jakartaapartmentsnew.com/two-sudirman/): 70-floor, 335-unit ultra-luxury tower by Mitsubishi Estate × Benhil Property × Taspen Properti. Jl. Sudirman Kav 2. From IDR 71M/sqm. Architecture NBBJ, interior Super Potato, structure ARUP. Handover Q1 2029.
- [Savyavasa Dharmawangsa](https://jakartaapartmentsnew.com/savyavasa/): Ultra-private compound by JSI x Hongkong Swire Properties. Jl. Dharmawangsa. Forest-in-city concept. 2BR from IDR 8.5Bn.
- [The Elements Kuningan](https://jakartaapartmentsnew.com/the-elements/): Foreigner ownership eligible, free BPHTB. CBD Rasuna. Japanese-grade specifications.
- [Raffles Residences Jakarta](https://jakartaapartmentsnew.com/raffles-residences-jakarta/): 88 ultra-exclusive units at Ciputra World 1, Kuningan. Accor/Raffles branded. 4BR 470–479 sqm, from IDR 25–30Bn.
- [La Vie All Suites](https://jakartaapartmentsnew.com/la-vie-all-suites/): 300 all-suite residences, Jl. Denpasar, Kuningan. Expat favourite. 2BR and 3BR.
- [57 Promenade Thamrin](https://jakartaapartmentsnew.com/57-promenade/): Intiland development, Thamrin Jakarta Pusat. Sky lounge 59F.
- [Branz Mega Kuningan](https://jakartaapartmentsnew.com/branz-mega-kuningan/): Tokyu Land Indonesia. Japanese pet-friendly standards. Free PPN. Ready stock.
- [Oakwood Premier Cozmo](https://jakartaapartmentsnew.com/oakwood-premier-cozmo/): Penthouse collection at 46-floor serviced tower. Mega Kuningan.

## Portfolio — External Sites

- [Regent Residences Jakarta](https://regent-jakarta.co/): IHG branded residences at Mangkuluhur City.
- [Verde Two Kuningan](https://verde2apartment.com/): Farpoint development. EDGE Zero Carbon certified. Pet-friendly.
